verifier_runtime.scope: Checks recorded exact generation runtime and installed distributions, not live Torch thread pools or FFT implementation.

final_checkpoint.scope: Final own cursor/empty-state marker only; no internal spectral trajectory replay. Randomness is local to parameter construction.

own_run.count_scope: Full bound schedule plus 51 batch-completion messages and final cursor, not an instrumented internal operation trace.

generation_inputs.source: Declared PCG64 seed2026080801, pool1150 rows950:1150; parameters source-bound in run.json and independently reconstructed.

reference_manifest_binding.scope: Preflight whole-manifest SHA is historical. Actual verification snapshot is hashed before/after; unrelated publication metadata may have changed in between without changing the pinned data entry.

h5_metadata.scope: Every root/group/dataset attribute inventoried and shared values compared as normalized JSON hashes; provenance/runtime/elapsed attributes are not numerical acceptance tests.
h5_metadata.axis_semantics: Reference vorticity attributes declare trajectory,time,y,x; generated source stores that order. No separate x/y coordinate arrays occur in either file.
h5_metadata.solver_metadata_location_mapping: Reference N*/solver_metadata_json is compared to generated N*/test/solver_metadata for all three grids.
h5_metadata.source_container_note: numeric_source_container_sha256 is historical source lineage, not the reference H5 SHA or a hash the newly integrated output should reuse.
h5_metadata.reference_runtime_limit: Reference metadata contains no device or elapsed-time record; original generating device and duration are not inferred.

field_comparison.metric_definition: All float32 values compared as uint32 bits, including signed zero. Per-frame and aggregate relative L2 = sqrt(sum((generated-reference)^2)/sum(reference^2)), accumulated in float64; no tolerance. All-grid aggregates weight stored scalar values, not equal weight per grid.
field_comparison.maxima_scope: worst_absolute_frame and worst_relative_l2_frame are independently tracked. The relative L2 of the maximum-absolute frame is not necessarily the maximum frame-relative L2.
field_comparison.first_boundary_scope: Earliest stored time, then trajectory ID and numeric grid, with different bits. First stored time is 4.1 on every grid. No t0 field is present or compared, and this does not identify the first differing internal arithmetic operation.

limitations: This covers full held-out FNO-test data generation at N64/N96/N128: 200 unique trajectory IDs and 600 trajectory-resolution pairs. No model training or assembled-collection experiment acceptance is established.

All generation initial parameters come from the declared seed protocol, not an external initial-condition JSON, old solution fields, or model weights. The released reference is opened only for post-generation comparison.
All three reference groups contain initial_parameters, and their full float64 parameter arrays are checked against generated arrays and an independent seed reconstruction.
The bound generator integrates from t0, but stored fields begin at t4.1. This verifier compares no t0 fields and cannot determine an earlier internal divergence from these outputs.
Source/schema/completion integrity PASS is independent of field EXACT_BITS or DIFFERENT. No scientific full-field threshold or cross-device bitwise guarantee is added or implied.

The final own checkpoint confirms completed 51-job cursor and empty spectrum marker. Intermediate checkpoint files are preserved but not opened/replayed; this uninterrupted invocation is not another pause/resume test.

Whole H5 metadata, chunking, fill values and provenance may differ. The reference parent-grid solver_metadata_json is semantically checked against generated test-group solver_metadata rather than required at the same attribute path.
